449:t_10:20.en:
$$ラルク$$
(But I... really am not... such a strong person...)

449:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$ノリコ$$ is usually bright and full of energy, but she carries loneliness in her heart after all.)

449:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$ノリコ$$'s feelings for her Big Sis produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

449:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Longing for someone you can never see again... Come to think of it, the multiverse is a cruel world where that happens so easily...)

449:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What seems to be the matter? Is something troubling $$ノノ$$, today's MVP?」

449:t_10:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「When everyone says that much to me, even $$ノノ$$ can't help worrying about it.」

449:t_10:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So I'm trying to remember all sorts of things, but...」

449:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Memory is a delicate thing, you see. Machines and humans are the same in that respect.」

449:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sometimes it comes back one day at some small trigger, and sometimes it stays lost forever.」

449:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, shall I perform the repair method I learned straight from $$ランド$$?」

449:t_10:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Could that be... by any chance...!」

449:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly! A finishing blow with angle, power, and speed all perfectly in place!」

449:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, don't say that...! Come here...!」

449:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Listen, $$ノノ$$...! How many times is this that you've broken my monitor!?」

449:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even someone as mild-mannered as I am has a patience meter that is completely in the red zone!」

449:t_10:46.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ＡＧ$$! I'm really, really sorry!」

449:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you reflecting on what you did?」

449:t_10:50.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's go all out at business again today - business, business!」

449:t_10:51.en:
$$ノノ$$
「This is what you wanted, right?」

449:t_10:53.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well then, $$ノノ$$ will get ready to sortie too. Now... let's do our best with Big Sis!」

449:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Lately, though, it seems to me that the ritual sacred to me has become an empty formality...」

450:t_000:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Brat $$シンジ$$... What were you doing, going to see $$ノノ$$?」

450:t_000:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Say it straight. Because you were dragging your feet, I ended up having to go get you, didn't I?」

450:t_000:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「If you've got time to play it cool, why not go look after your $$姫$$, nya?」

450:t_000:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Are you sure it's okay to go out with just one unit, $$ラルク$$?」

450:t_000:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can move more freely this way.」

450:t_000:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're not very honest, are you, $$姫$$?」

450:t_000:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ラルク$$... $$ノノ$$ will surely come back.」

450:t_000:12.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It's no use. She went off to look for a $$バスターマシン$$.」

450:t_000:14.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She's going to get a $$バスターマシン$$ and become $$ノノリリ$$...」

450:t_000:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
(She doesn't need to become $$ノノリリ$$... It would be enough if she just stayed with me...)

450:t_000:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Won't any new $$バスターマシン$$ be built?」

450:t_000:17.en:
$$チコ$$
「Thanks to the $$時空震動$$, all the development plans got wiped clean.」

450:t_000:18.en:
$$チコ$$
「At worst, my $$キャトフヴァンディス$$ might be the last one.」

450:t_000:19.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I guess... And in this world, no new $$トップレス$$ recruits are likely to show up either.」

450:t_000:20.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That might not be the case, actually.」

450:t_000:21.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you mean, $$ニコラ$$?」

450:t_000:22.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It seems the children of this world are also showing the emergence of abilities similar to $$トップレス$$.」

450:t_000:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then maybe I could pilot $$トライダーＧ７$$ with an $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$ too!」

450:t_000:25.en:
$$木下$$
「If that happens, we'd save on fuel costs, and it would be a great help to our company too!」

450:t_000:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「You've got no dreams, Big Bro $$木下$$.」

450:t_000:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Is what you said just now true?」

450:t_000:28.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's reliable information from a certain source.」

450:t_000:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Although it seems that over there, even your $$ニュータイプ$$ powers, Captain, are treated as one of the $$トップレス$$ abilities.」

450:t_000:30.en:
$$シャア$$
「If so, do Newtypes also lose their power as they grow older?」

450:t_000:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What do you mean by that...?」

450:t_000:33.en:
$$シャア$$
「Every child has the power of $$トップレス$$ to a greater or lesser degree, but it's lost with age...」

450:t_000:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「When one reaches the phenomenon called '《$$あがり$$》', the power of $$トップレス$$ is lost, and one can no longer pilot a $$バスターマシン$$ either.」

450:t_000:35.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You seem to know a great deal.」

450:t_000:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even I can gather this much information.」

450:t_000:37.en:
$$シン$$
「Huh... first I've heard of it.」

450:t_000:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「Of course it is. None of the $$トップレス$$ folks told us either.」

450:t_000:39.en:
$$葵$$
「We had heard it from $$チコ$$, though.」

450:t_000:40.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「However, let's leave this topic here. It seems to be a delicate subject for $$トップレス$$.」

450:t_000:43.en:
$$タケル$$
(Colonel $$シャア$$ knew about that, and still brought up this topic on purpose...?)

450:t_000:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Was that to keep $$ニコラ$$ in check, whose true intentions are still unclear...? Typical of an adult.)
